season: Game 1.4.002 (after the 2026-09-23 stage easing) · Dimensional Rift season 1 (to 2026-10-08)
lede: What Korean players push main stages and the Dimensional Rift with while under-powered: the brackets, the 35% and 15% teams, and the per-boss swaps.
caveat: Main stages as of 2026-09-28, the Rift as of 2026-10-03. Main-stage 15% boss clears are claimed, never shown; Rift 15% screenshots reach level 18, never GingerCraven.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.
formation_slots: A deck cookie's slot reads row<R>-<C> as in record 002: R is the row on the owner's formation screen (1 = top), C the column left to right. Only the all-in-one deck (dc:70308) posts its slots.

you.summary: Push at 35% with the Bari–Cherry Cola–Brightseeker deck, swapping per boss slot; use 15% only on mob stages; pad power across the next line before a boss.
changes: Build a stage gear preset rolled for power (accuracy about 1,000) and a Skill Haste preset for auto; switch to power just under a line.
Keep SSR sugar-rune lines that add power (crit resist included) until you reach the Rift, then re-roll.
Keep Panda Dumpling for launch bosses, and Scorpion or Jungle Warrior for the ruined-city and snowfield -30s.
Find your 40% and 20% lines in stage-chapters.json: push at 35% to the 40% line, then only mob stages until the next.
At about 2.2G on a stage preset: 55% reaches 288-3, 35% reaches 304-19, 15% covers every stage to 328-30 (from the game data).
Reach 328-30 (4.00G for 35%) early: the Rift's 차원의 힘 grows only while you are in it, and early entrants compound.
In the Rift, read your bracket off the header power, never the formation screen: 15% from 20% of the level's recommended power.
Twist the levels between GingerCraven levels at 15% with the rift-15-* decks; park at each GingerCraven level until 차원의 힘 lifts you to its 35% line.

stage.lede: Main stages (328 chapters of 30 stages, cycling through eight zones) and the Dimensional Rift (seasonal, boss-only, opened 2026-09-23 for players past 328-30).
stage.caveat: Pre-easing clears (before 2026-09-23) were made against higher recommended power for 169-1 to 328-30; stage-clears.json marks the era of each.

rules.title: Structure
rules.body: Chapters of 30 stages (243-30). The -10, -20 and -30 stages hold the bosses (or packs of up to ten); the rest are mob stages.

rules.title: The end and the Rift
rules.body: Stages run to 328-30 since 2026-09-10; clearing 328-30 opens the Dimensional Rift.

rules.title: Team and presets
rules.body: 12 cookies, 3 pets, a captain and mercenary band perks, as in the other modes.

rules.title: Which gear preset fights
rules.body: The stage uses the preset chosen on the formation (편성) screen, not the gear menu's; presets switch between stage, arena and conquest sets.

rules.title: Idle rewards and boss retries
rules.body: Your parked stage sets idle rewards. Bosses start from a boss summon; with auto-summon on, a deck retries unattended.
